observations.title: Recheck: #BuildHybridAI Sprint 2 quota request closes November 18 at 10 AM Pacific
observations.claim: Google's official #BuildHybridAI rules remain accessible and confirm that the Sprint 2 optional Google Account Quota request is due Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 10:00 AM Pacific, with approved accounts sent November 19. Sprint 3 requests are due November 25 at 10:00 AM Pacific, with accounts sent November 27. Each approved quota account is valid for four days and approval is discretionary. Contest submissions close November 30 at 2:00 PM Pacific. The official prize pool is $30,000 total, including a $10,000 Grand Prize; prizes are not guaranteed. Solo entries are permitted, but submissions must use Firebase AI Logic at runtime, App Check, a public open-source repository, a functioning demo, and a public YouTube demonstration no longer than three minutes.
observations.why_now: The scheduled November 18 recheck confirms the imminent Sprint 2 quota cutoff and the final Sprint 3 request date. No change to the published contest terms was found.
observations.observed_delta: Rechecked the official rules on the Sprint 2 request date. The request cutoff is now within approximately twelve hours of this check; no contest-term change was found.
observations.value: $30,000 total contest prize pool, including a $10,000 Grand Prize; awards are competitive and not guaranteed. Optional Google Account Quota is discretionary, lasts four days, and is not cash.
observations.eligibility: Adults in eligible jurisdictions; the United States is not listed among excluded jurisdictions. Individual/solo entries are allowed. The project must use Firebase AI Logic at runtime and meet App Check, public open-source repository, functioning demo, free evaluation access, and public YouTube video requirements.
observations.friction: Sprint 2 quota request closes November 18 at 10:00 AM Pacific; approval is discretionary and any issued account lasts four days. Sprint 3 closes November 25 at 10:00 AM Pacific. Submission closes November 30 at 2:00 PM Pacific. Existing projects must be significantly updated after November 11. The Firebase AI Logic integration, App Check, public repository/license, demo and video are substantial work; fees outside the provisioned quota remain the entrant's responsibility.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not divert SECONDS MATTER for a speculative prize. The $30,000 is a pool, not a grant or guaranteed income; quota approval is discretionary and temporary. No application or quota request is assumed.

observations.title: Upwork HVAC buyer requests $150 GHL CRM, follow-up and missed-call setup
observations.claim: An Upwork-indexed $150 fixed-price, one-time listing requests GoHighLevel CRM pipelines for HVAC inquiries, inspections, estimates and completed jobs; assignment and follow-up automation; SMS/email sequences with stop conditions; missed-call text-back; booking; lead-source reporting; and a team walkthrough. The current indexed snapshot shows 50+ proposals and one interview, with no job-specific hire displayed. The client's account profile shows approximately $20,000 total historical spend and 565 hires, but those are account-wide figures and do not establish an award or payment for this listing. The listing title says posted November 16 while the indexed body says 'Posted 1 hour ago'; posting-age metadata is inconsistent. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403.
observations.why_now: First observed in the current research run. It is a relevant home-services implementation request with an established client account, but the low fixed budget and heavy competition make it a weak service-price benchmark.
observations.observed_delta: New marketplace listing not present in the existing 33-subject journal. Captures explicit implementation intent for HVAC CRM, missed-call text-back and outcome reporting; no job-specific hire or payment is established.
observations.value: $150 fixed-price one-time listing; no award, funded milestone or settled payment verified.
observations.eligibility: Worldwide listing for a GoHighLevel specialist, ideally with HVAC or other home-services workflow experience. The public client profile is associated with a US Virgin Islands account.
observations.friction: 50+ proposals and one interview indicate heavy competition. The fixed budget is $150 for a broad CRM and automation scope. Direct page retrieval is blocked with HTTP 403, and the search result has inconsistent posting-age metadata. Client-wide spend and hire totals are not attributable to this job.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not treat a low one-time implementation budget as recurring product willingness-to-pay. Avoid competing on generic low-price GHL setup; the differentiated hypothesis remains callback accountability and verified recovery outcomes.

observations.title: Recheck: $1,500 home-services voice-AI snapshot passed its November 17 v1 milestone without a visible job outcome
observations.claim: The current Upwork search-index snapshot continues to show the $1,500 fixed-price home-services voice-AI snapshot project with 20–50 proposals and 16 interviews. Its advertised Snapshot v1 milestone was due November 17, 2026 and has now passed; the final handoff milestone is listed for November 20. The client's account profile displays approximately $292 total historical spend and two hires, but those aggregate account figures do not establish that this specific job was awarded, funded, or completed. No job-specific milestone or payment outcome is visible. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403, so the listing's live status and outcome remain unresolved.
observations.why_now: The prior recheck date and the advertised Snapshot v1 milestone have passed. The remaining November 20 handoff date creates a specific next verification point; no job-specific outcome can currently be confirmed.
observations.observed_delta: Material time-based recheck: Snapshot v1 due November 17 has passed, while handoff is listed for November 20. Client-account spend and hire totals are now visible in the search snapshot but are not attributable to this job.
observations.value: $1,500 total fixed-price project across three advertised milestones; no job-specific award, funded milestone, completed delivery or settled payment verified.
observations.eligibility: Worldwide, expert-level GoHighLevel voice-AI builder; listing asks for two live home-services voice-AI examples, a screen-share walkthrough, and US Eastern-hours overlap.
observations.friction: 20–50 proposals and 16 interviews; direct listing retrieval is blocked. Snapshot v1 milestone has passed, but job-specific status is not visible. Client-profile totals are account-wide and must not be treated as project revenue or proof of hire.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not count account-wide spend or hires as this job's result. A listing and interview count are not payment; retain as unresolved hiring intent until a job-specific outcome is visible.
